{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Total number of enrolled patients
total_patients = len(df)

# Number of patients with SEVERE baseline disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe'].shape[0]

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

# Print each number explicitly to ensure they are produced by code
print(total_patients)
print(severe_patients)
print(fraction_severe)

# Now, ensure the final answer uses only printed values
final_fraction = round(fraction_severe, 3)
print(final_fraction)"}
